name: Features — Stacked card reveal
description: Four feature cards that stack on top of each other as you scroll, each revealing then translating up to make room for the next.
html:
01 / 04

Carbon-Neutral Manufacturing

Our proprietary closed-loop production system eliminates 94% of industrial waste. Every gram of material is tracked from source to finished product, ensuring complete supply chain transparency for enterprise partners.

02 / 04

Predictive Supply Chain AI

Machine learning models trained on 12 years of global logistics data forecast demand fluctuations 18 months in advance. Partners reduce inventory costs by an average of 34% while maintaining 99.7% fulfillment rates.

03 / 04

Modular Product Architecture

Interchangeable component systems extend product lifecycles by 400%. When technology evolves, individual modules upgrade without full replacement—dramatically reducing total cost of ownership for deployed fleets.

04 / 04

Real-Time Performance Analytics

Edge computing sensors embedded in every unit transmit operational data every 50 milliseconds. Dashboards reveal efficiency patterns invisible to human observation, unlocking continuous optimization for mission-critical deployments.

name: Features — Horizontal pinned scroll
description: Three feature panels laid out horizontally and revealed via horizontal scroll-pin.
html:
01 / Performance

Engineered for Speed

Every millisecond counts. Our infrastructure processes 2.4 million transactions per second with sub-10ms latency, powering the world's most demanding real-time applications.

  • Global edge deployment across 280+ PoPs
  • 99.999% uptime SLA with automatic failover
  • Custom silicon optimized for ML inference
02 / Security

Zero-Trust Architecture

Security isn't a feature—it's the foundation. Our platform is SOC 2 Type II certified and processes payments for 40% of Fortune 500 companies with complete data sovereignty.

  • End-to-end encryption with HSM-backed keys
  • Real-time threat detection with 99.97% accuracy
  • Region-specific data residency compliance
03 / Scale

Limitless Growth

From seed-stage startup to IPO-ready enterprise. Our platform automatically scales from thousands to billions of requests without configuration changes or performance degradation.

  • Auto-scaling compute with millisecond provisioning
  • Petabyte-scale storage with instant retrieval
  • Multi-region active-active replication
